mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting a quote for a backyard cottage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before consulting with a contractor, gather your property survey, list your functional goals, and check for any neighborhood association restrictions. A recent boundary survey helps verify where property lines, utility easements, and setback buffers lie in your yard. Decide whether the cottage is meant for multigenerational family living, short-term guest accommodations, or a home workspace, as this dictates the need for a full kitchen versus a kitchenette. Having these items organized allows your builder to give an accurate assessment of where the structure can legally sit and what design approach best matches your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, identify your planned use for the space, and check any HOA guidelines so your builder can assess setback limits and site feasibility.
